Salat-e-Mustaqeem API

A comprehensive, accurate, and easy-to-use RESTful API for Islamic prayer times, Hijri calendar, and Qibla direction calculations.

View on GitHubAPI Documentation
$ curl "https://node-api.imuslimlife.com/api/v1/prayer-times/by-coordinates?latitude=28.5383&longitude=-81.3792"

{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "date": "2025-04-04",
    "prayerTimes": {
      "fajr": "05:28 AM",
      "sunrise": "06:45 AM",
      "dhuhr": "12:55 PM",
      "asr": "04:36 PM",

API Documentation
Getting StartedAuthenticationAPI EndpointsCalculation MethodsRate LimitsClient Libraries

Overview

The Salat-e-Mustaqeem API provides accurate Islamic prayer times, Hijri calendar conversion, and Qibla direction calculations. It's designed to be easy to integrate into any application that requires Islamic prayer time data.

Our API is built on modern web standards and is fully RESTful. All responses are returned as JSON, making it easy to parse and use in any programming language.

Getting Started

The base URL for all API requests is:

https://node-api.imuslimlife.com

All endpoints return a consistent response format with a success boolean and a data object containing the requested information. In case of errors, an error object is returned with details about what went wrong.

// Successful response format
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... }
}

// Error response format
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_PARAMETERS",
    "message": "The latitude parameter is required"
  }
}

Authentication

The API currently offers two authentication methods:

1. API Key (Recommended)

Include your API key in the request header:

X-API-Key: your_api_key_here
2. Query Parameter

Alternatively, you can include the API key as a query parameter:

https://node-api.imuslimlife.com/api/v1/prayer-times/by-coordinates?latitude=28.5383&longitude=-81.3792&api_key=your_api_key_here

Note: To obtain an API key, please sign up for a free account on our API portal. The free tier provides up to 1,000 requests per day.

API Endpoints

GET

/api/v1/prayer-times/by-coordinates

Get prayer times using latitude and longitude coordinates

Parameters
NameTypeRequiredDescription
latitudenumberYesLatitude coordinate
longitudenumberYesLongitude coordinate
datestringNoDate in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)
methodnumberNoCalculation method ID (0-23, 99 for custom, defaults to 2)
Example Request
https://node-api.imuslimlife.com/api/v1/prayer-times/by-coordinates?latitude=28.5383&longitude=-81.3792&method=2
Sample Code

fetch('https://node-api.imuslimlife.com/api/v1/prayer-times/by-coordinates?latitude=28.5383&longitude=-81.3792&method=2')
  .then(response => response.json())
  .then(data => console.log(data))
  .catch(error => console.error('Error:', error));
Example Response
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "date": "2025-04-04",
    "gregorian": "April 4, 2025",
    "hijri": "1446-09-05",
    "location": {
      "latitude": 28.5383,
      "longitude": -81.3792
    },
    "method": {
      "id": 2,
      "name": "Islamic Society of North America (ISNA)"
    },
    "prayerTimes": {
      "fajr": "05:28 AM",
      "sunrise": "06:45 AM",
      "dhuhr": "12:55 PM",
      "asr": "04:36 PM",
      "maghrib": "07:06 PM",
      "isha": "08:23 PM"
    },
    "timestamp": {
      "fajr": 1712222880,
      "sunrise": 1712227500,
      "dhuhr": 1712249700,
      "asr": 1712258160,
      "maghrib": 1712270760,
      "isha": 1712275380
    }
  }
}

GET

/api/v1/prayer-times/by-address

Get prayer times using a text address

Parameters
NameTypeRequiredDescription
addressstringYesFull address or city name
datestringNoDate in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)
methodnumberNoCalculation method ID (0-23, 99 for custom, defaults to 2)
Example Request
https://node-api.imuslimlife.com/api/v1/prayer-times/by-address?address=Orlando, FL&method=2
Sample Code

fetch('https://node-api.imuslimlife.com/api/v1/prayer-times/by-address?address=Orlando, FL&method=2')
  .then(response => response.json())
  .then(data => console.log(data))
  .catch(error => console.error('Error:', error));
Example Response
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "date": "2025-04-04",
    "gregorian": "April 4, 2025",
    "hijri": "1446-09-05",
    "location": {
      "latitude": 28.5383,
      "longitude": -81.3792,
      "address": "Orlando, FL, USA"
    },
    "method": {
      "id": 2,
      "name": "Islamic Society of North America (ISNA)"
    },
    "prayerTimes": {
      "fajr": "05:28 AM",
      "sunrise": "06:45 AM",
      "dhuhr": "12:55 PM",
      "asr": "04:36 PM",
      "maghrib": "07:06 PM",
      "isha": "08:23 PM"
    }
  }
}

Calculation Methods

The API supports multiple calculation methods for determining prayer times. Each method uses different parameters for calculating Fajr and Isha prayer times, based on regional preferences and traditional practices.

IDMethodCommonly Used In
0Jafari (Shia Ithna-Ashari)Iran, Iraq, Lebanon (Shia)
1University of Islamic Sciences, KarachiPakistan, Afghanistan, Bangladesh, India
2Islamic Society of North America (ISNA)North America, Parts of Europe
3Muslim World LeagueEurope, Far East, Parts of US
4Umm Al-Qura University, MakkahSaudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, UAE
5Egyptian General Authority of SurveyEgypt, Sudan, Africa
7Institute of Geophysics, University of TehranIran, Some Shia Communities
8Gulf RegionOman, UAE, Yemen
9KuwaitKuwait
10QatarQatar
11Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura, SingaporeSingapore, Malaysia, Indonesia
12Union Organization islamic de FranceFrance
13Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı, TurkeyTurkey
14Spiritual Administration of Muslims of RussiaRussia, CIS Countries
15Moonsighting Committee WorldwideGlobal (Moon sighting based)
16Dubai, UAEDubai
17JAKIM, MalaysiaMalaysia
18TunisiaTunisia
19AlgeriaAlgeria
20Kemenag, IndonesiaIndonesia
21MoroccoMorocco
22PortugalPortugal
23JordanJordan
99Custom SettingsCustom Configuration

If no method is specified, the API defaults to Method 2 (ISNA). Some methods may require additional parameters for accurate calculations.

Note: Method 15 (Moonsighting Committee) may require an additional shafaq parameter. Method 99 (Custom) allows you to define your own parameters for Fajr and Isha calculations.

Rate Limits

To ensure fair usage and availability of the API for all users, we implement rate limiting based on your subscription tier:

PlanLimitPrice
Free Tier1,000 requests per dayFree
Developer10,000 requests per day$9.99/month
Business100,000 requests per day$29.99/month
EnterpriseCustom limitsContact us
Rate Limit Headers

Each API response includes headers that show your current rate limit status:

X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000           # Your total daily limit
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 985         # Requests remaining in current period
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1712015999      # Unix timestamp when the limit resets

Client Libraries

We provide official client libraries for various programming languages to make it easier to integrate with our API:

JavaScript

A Node.js and browser-compatible JavaScript client

View on GitHub
Python

Python client library with async support

View on GitHub
Coming Soon

Libraries for PHP, Java, Swift, and more are in development.

If you'd like to contribute a client library in another language, please check our contribution guidelines.

Open Source

Salat-e-Mustaqeem API is open-source software licensed under the MIT license. We welcome contributions from the community.

API Source Code

View the backend API source code on GitHub. The API is built with Node.js and Express.

GitHub Repository
Frontend Source Code

This web application is built with React and Material-UI and is also open source.

GitHub Repository

If you have any questions, issues, or feature requests, please don't hesitate to reach out to us:
